answer.reason: The Gospels tell of Pilate's trial of Jesus and its aftermath, which give two or three chief deeds beyond the summary.

clauses.english: washed his hands before the crowd, declaring himself innocent of Jesus' blood
clauses.quote: he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude

clauses.english: released Barabbas and delivered Jesus to be crucified, after scourging him
clauses.quote: released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified

clauses.english: gave Joseph of Arimathaea leave to take the body of Jesus

doubts: LUK 13:1 (Galilaeans' blood mingled with sacrifices) left out as only reported in passing.
Writing the title on the cross (JHN 19:19-22) left out as a lesser detail.
